Title: Add a new pet — valid payload
Steps:
1. Send POST /pet with valid JSON body (name, photoUrls, status)
2. Verify response status
3. Verify response body contains pet ID and name
Expected Result: Status 200. Response contains pet with matching name, category, and status. Pet ID is returned.

Title: Update an existing pet
Preconditions: Pet ID 91001 exists in the store
Steps:
1. Send PUT /pet with updated status (sold)
2. Verify response
3. Send GET /pet/{petId} to confirm update
Expected Result: Status 200. Pet status updated to 'sold'. GET confirms the change persisted.

Title: Find pets by status — available
Preconditions: At least one pet with status 'available' exists
Steps:
1. Send GET /pet/findByStatus?status=available
2. Verify response is a non-empty array
3. Verify all returned pets have status 'available'
Expected Result: Status 200. Array of pets returned. Every pet object has status = 'available'.

Title: Find pets by tags (deprecated endpoint)
Steps:
1. Send GET /pet/findByTags?tags=golden-retriever
2. Verify response
3. Note: endpoint is marked deprecated in spec
Expected Result: Status 200. Array returned (endpoint still responds despite deprecation). No sunset header present.

Title: Get pet by valid ID
Steps:
1. Send GET /pet/{petId} with a valid pet ID
2. Verify response status and body structure
3. Verify required fields: id, name, photoUrls
Expected Result: Status 200. Response contains pet with correct ID, name, photoUrls, and status.

Title: Update pet with form data
Steps:
1. Send POST /pet/{petId} with Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
2. Include name and status fields
3. Verify update via GET
Expected Result: Status 200. Pet name and status updated when retrieved.

Title: Delete a pet
Steps:
1. Send DELETE /pet/{petId} with api_key header
2. Verify response
3. Send GET /pet/{petId} to confirm deletion
Expected Result: Status 200 on delete. Subsequent GET returns 404.

Title: Upload pet image
Steps:
1. Send POST /pet/{petId}/uploadImage with multipart/form-data
2. Include an image file and additionalMetadata
3. Verify response
Expected Result: Status 200. ApiResponse with code 200 and message containing 'File uploaded'.

Title: Get store inventory
Preconditions: Store has at least one pet
Steps:
1. Send GET /store/inventory
2. Verify response is a JSON object
3. Verify Content-Type header
Expected Result: Status 200. JSON object with status names as keys and counts as values.

Title: Place an order — valid payload
Steps:
1. Send POST /store/order with valid JSON (petId, quantity, shipDate, status)
2. Verify response status and body
3. Verify order ID is returned
Expected Result: Status 200. Order returned with matching petId, status 'placed', and a valid order ID.

Title: Find order by valid ID
Steps:
1. Send GET /store/order/{orderId}
2. Verify response body matches placed order
Expected Result: Status 200. Order object with correct ID, petId, quantity, and status.

Title: Delete an order
Expected Result: Status 200 on delete. Subsequent GET returns 404.

Title: Create a single user
Steps:
1. Send POST /user with valid user JSON
2. Verify response
Expected Result: Status 200. ApiResponse with message containing user ID.

Title: Create users with array
Steps:
1. Send POST /user/createWithArray with array of 2 user objects
2. Verify response
Expected Result: Status 200. ApiResponse indicates success.

Title: Create users with list
Steps:
1. Send POST /user/createWithList with list of 1 user object
2. Verify response
Expected Result: Status 200. ApiResponse indicates success.

Title: Login — valid credentials
Steps:
1. Send GET /user/login?username=qaengineer&password=Test@1234
2. Verify response contains session info
Expected Result: Status 200. Message includes 'logged in user session' with session token.

Title: Logout user
Steps:
1. Send GET /user/logout
2. Verify response
Expected Result: Status 200. Logout confirmation returned.

Title: Get user by username
Steps:
1. Send GET /user/{username}
2. Verify username, email, and other fields match
Expected Result: Status 200. User object with correct username, firstName, lastName, email.

Title: Update user
Steps:
1. Send PUT /user/{username} with updated email and phone
2. Verify response
3. Send GET /user/{username} to confirm
Expected Result: Status 200. Updated fields reflected on subsequent GET.

Title: Delete user
Expected Result: Status 200 on delete. Subsequent GET returns 404.

Title: Get pet with invalid ID (negative)
Steps:
1. Send GET /pet/invalidId (non-numeric string)
2. Verify error response
Expected Result: Status 400 or 404. Error message returned (actual: inconsistent — sometimes returns NumberFormatException).

Title: Get deleted pet (negative)
Steps:
1. Delete a pet
2. Immediately send GET /pet/{petId}
Expected Result: Status 404. Pet not found message.

Title: Find order with out-of-range ID (negative)
Steps:
1. Send GET /store/order/9999
2. Verify error response
Expected Result: Status 404. Order not found (spec says IDs must be 1–10).

Title: Get deleted user (negative)
Steps:
1. Delete a user
2. Immediately send GET /user/{username}
Expected Result: Status 404. User not found message.

Title: Add pet without required field (negative)
Steps:
1. Send POST /pet with body missing 'name' field
2. Verify error response
Expected Result: Expected: Status 400 with validation error. Actual: API returns 200 (BUG — see BUG-003).
